four_fields.mechanism: Start from exact eligible frequency-per-byte selection/no-cache; bounded one/two-view exchanges on consumer hypergraph, whole-plan route costing without duplicate parent/child credit, peak cached+working/disk constraints and explicit snapshot lifecycle.
four_fields.prediction: Complementary views completing a batch may outperform individually frequent views; cold build, no repeat, snapshot churn, common reads or support state may make no-cache cheapest.
four_fields.nearest_finite_experiment: UNRUN graph≤6 versioned views,4 consumers,2 snapshots,≤64 distinct scored/rejected plans; independent exact-subset planning oracle and literal full-output expectations; complementarity/overlap/no-benefit adversaries.
four_fields.task1_benefit: Test whether human-bounded exact feature plans can automatically choose reuse state under realistic lifecycle budgets without quality/model changes.

selection_contract.views: Exact semantic+source/adapter/availability/context/anchor-window/multiplicity/NULL/metadata/coverage/projected-key identity and complete physical masks/supports; only proven rewrites eligible.
selection_contract.hypergraph: Consumers and needed exact outputs plus declared common execution dependencies; complete a batch only when every required output/dependency is supplied. Partial replacement may save aggregate update work but not necessarily source scan.
selection_contract.overlap: One consumer route chosen compatibly; compute shared work once in joint plan, never add standalone parent and child savings. Logical overlap is not observed physical sharing.
selection_contract.baseline: Same eligible views, source/output/identity/peak constraints, estimates and lifecycle; frequency/byte greedy then best of its selection and no-cache, no artificially forced bad materialization.
selection_contract.intervention: Deterministic bounded 1/2-view exchanges; semantic-signature tie order, memoized evaluated subsets, strict predicted lifecycle-cost improvement,≤64 distinct candidate/rejected plans in tiny proposal. No global-optimality guarantee.
selection_contract.lifecycle: Cold construction paid; fixed consumer order and snapshot versions, declared build/last-use eviction and conservative invalidation. Next-anchor/source changes do not authorize automatic old snapshot reuse.
selection_contract.memory_disk: Peak sum of simultaneous cache plus building/consumer working payloads and index/hash overhead; disk peak includes old/new replacement coexistence, serialization/temp and spill. Final output bytes insufficient.
selection_contract.semantics: Strictpast/global peers/fullkeys/raw duplicates, NULL and known-empty/unsupported/coverage unchanged; exact DISTINCT scalars cannot be unioned/coarsened/expired without sufficient state. Full metadata/denominators remain.
selection_contract.real_plan_unknown: Current code batches grain/anchor, but no actual physical plans or costs inspected/executed; hypothetical graph savings do not certify current005 IO/CPU.

strong_controls.planning: Frequency-per-byte/no-cache under identical estimates/eligibility/lifecycle and independent exhaustive subset oracle for the≤6-view graph.
strong_controls.calculation: Independent literal exact keyed values/masks/supports; never merely row-count/hash-hit summaries.
strong_controls.physical_future: Unchanged optimized batched005 with identical full output/sink/readback, full cold initialization and fixed subsequent reuse consumers; both policy overheads charged.

worst_cases: No repeated consumer: cache build/write/read overhead dominates.
Disjoint anchor/source versions invalidate all reuse.
Mandatory other aggregates/metadata keep scans or physical pages needed; logical batch closure does not guarantee reduced IO.
Highly overlapping parent/child views cause duplicate standalone benefit or wasted storage.
Two small independent final outputs may coexist with large builders/sets and breach peak RAM/disk.
DISTINCT support approaches raw cardinality; scalar cache cannot supply union/expiry semantics.
cheapest_UNRUN_falsifier: Independent full output mismatch, incomplete batch falsely suppressed, double-counted savings, stale version accepted, or any peak budget violation rejects. No predicted cold+warm benefit in matched tiny adversaries defers intervention; no measured physical speedup inferred.
